source.author: verg
source.text: Tum quassans caput haec effundit pectore dicta:
source.text_original: Tum quassans caput haec effundit pectore dicta: /
source.text_english: Then, shaking her head, she poured forth these words from her heart:

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: affremit his quassatque caput qui vellera dono Bellipotens sibi fixa videt, temptataque contra Pallas et amborum gemuit Saturnia questus.
reuse.text_original: ' / affremit his quassatque caput qui vellera dono / Bellipotens sibi fixa videt, temptataque contra / Pallas et amborum gemuit Saturnia questus.
reuse.text_english: He growls at this, and shakes his head, he who sees the fleece fixed to himself as a gift by the war-god’s might; and Pallas, having tested it in return, and the Saturnian goddess groaned at the complaints of them both.
